_about: Reviewer rulings applied on top of the model-written coverage tests (coverage.py). Keyed by jurisdiction|category (+ optional citation_contains). Each entry names the ruling it implements so the judges can trace it. Never silently changes a rule's text; only the engine tests.

overrides.ruling: instructions/rulings_05.md #1: S.F. Admin. Code § 37.9 just-cause protection extends to units regardless of construction date; D079 states inclusions, not exclusions. Treat coverage as all residential rental units in SF. Remaining statutory exemptions are not testable from parcel data and rare in a 5+ unit sample.

set.explanation_note: statutory exemptions (certain owner-occupied shared units, institutional housing) not testable from county data

overrides.ruling: instructions/rulings_05.md #2: tenancy length is a tenant-level fact that decides when an increase may be taken, not whether the building is covered. Drop the tenancy_months test; keep COO 1980 cutoff, condo/single-family, dormitory/co-op and golden-duplex tests.

instructions/rulings_06.md #2.3: the RSO (incl. its eviction section § 151.09) covers units with a certificate of occupancy on or before 1 Oct 1978. year_built < 1978 -> applies; == 1978 -> unknown (cutoff year); > 1978 -> does not apply (the JCO governs instead). The merged record's own text only says 'units covered by the RSO', so the cutoff is restated here from LAMC § 151.02 (rental units first built on or before October 1, 1978).

add_tests.source_text: LAMC § 151.02: rental units ... first built on or before October 1, 1978 (RSO coverage)
add_tests.note: year built is a proxy for the certificate date; 1978 itself -> unknown

overrides.ruling: instructions/rulings_06.md #4: Hoboken Code § 155-5 cap (lesser of 5% or CPI, once per 12 months), applicability § 155-2. Built on or before 1987-06-25 -> applies; built after and 30 full years before the query date -> applies; otherwise post-1987 -> unknown (exemption lasts the shorter of the mortgage term or 30 years; mortgage term not in data); year missing -> unknown. No unit-count test. Hotels/motels and institutional/government housing are niche exemptions.

tests.note: built on or before the N.J.S.A. 2A:42-84.1 date -> covered

tests.source_text: for a period ... or for 30 years following completion of construction, whichever is less
tests.note: post-1987 building whose exemption has expired

tests.source_text: § 155-2(H): multiple dwellings constructed after June 25, 1987 exempt for the lesser of the initial mortgage amortisation period or 30 years
tests.note: the exemption's actual length (mortgage term, statutory filings) is not in the data

tests.source_text: § 155-2(A)-(F): motels/hotels, industrial, commercial units, institutional student housing, government-owned housing
